rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 0, lines 4-6: closest to orphan is the one-sentence line 6, but it states the consequence ('every model release widens the gap'), a self-carrying claim; slide holds a full argument.

line 1 header asks 'Will your organisation learn faster than the model changes underneath it?'; lines 4-6 answer by naming the two rates (model free, company knowledge only when written down) and the gap. Closest: question form, but body does not contradict it.

grep of lines 4-6: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; no anaphora triple (two sentences open 'The model'/'What your company'/'If what', not repeated legs); no superlative; no number; no abstraction-noun stack ('the gap' is concrete via line 4); no verb triplet.
